name: Drutopia Article
description: Config-only Features module that ships an Article content type, its fields, view/form displays, a search-driven listing view with facets, pathauto patterns, an article_type taxonomy vocabulary, and role permission grants; part of the Drutopia distribution.
project_description: Drutopia Article is a base feature (Features bundle 'drutopia') of the Drutopia distribution. It is a config-only module: it ships no PHP, routes, services, hooks, or permissions of its own. Installing it imports an Article node type, its fields (body, summary, image/media image, tags, topics, authors, article type, paragraph body, meta tags, comments), form and view displays, a Search API-backed listing view with topic and type facets, pathauto URL patterns, an 'article_type' taxonomy vocabulary, and config actions that grant article permissions to the Drutopia contributor/editor/manager roles. Installed here as a dev checkout (info.yml has no version line); the version directory tracks the 2.0.x dev branch. It carries the full Drutopia dependency chain (drutopia_core/comment/people/seo/site plus ds, facets, field_group, paragraphs, pathauto, metatag, search_api, media, and more) and is normally installed through the distribution rather than standalone.
